description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::StatusOr class, including tests for move semantics, conversions, constructors, assignment operators, and various usage scenarios, primarily using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks.

classes.name: CopyDetector
classes.description: A class used in tests to verify copy and move semantics, tracking whether it was copied or moved.

classes.name: Base1
classes.description: A base class with a virtual destructor, used for inheritance tests.

classes.name: Base2
classes.description: Another base class with a virtual destructor, used for inheritance and conversion tests.

classes.name: Derived
classes.description: A class inheriting from Base1 and Base2, used in pointer and conversion tests.

classes.name: CopyNoAssign
classes.description: A class with a copy constructor but no assignment operator, used to test copy semantics.

classes.name: Foo
classes.description: A simple struct with an explicit constructor, used in in-place construction tests.

classes.name: InPlaceHelper
classes.description: A struct with initializer list and unique_ptr members, used in in-place init list tests.

classes.name: A
classes.description: A simple struct with an int member, used in conversion tests.

classes.name: ImplicitConstructibleFromA
classes.description: A struct with implicit constructors from A, used in conversion tests.

classes.name: ExplicitConstructibleFromA
classes.description: A struct with explicit constructors from A, used in conversion tests.

classes.name: ImplicitConstructibleFromBool
classes.description: A struct with implicit constructor from bool, used in boolean conversion tests.

classes.name: ConvertibleToBool
classes.description: A struct with explicit operator bool, used in boolean conversion tests.

classes.name: CustomType
classes.description: A template class with conditional conversion operators to test various conversion scenarios for StatusOr.

classes.name: ConvertibleToAnyStatusOr
classes.description: A struct with a template conversion operator to absl::StatusOr<T>, used to test overload resolution.

classes.name: MyType
classes.description: A simple struct with an operator==, used in status tests.

methods.name: ReturnUniquePtr
methods.description: Returns a StatusOr containing a unique_ptr to int, used in move semantics tests.

methods.name: MakeStatus
methods.description: Returns a StatusOr<int> with value 100, used in ignore error test.
